As of build 772 Youtube livestreams are still not working
Entering a youtube livestream url results in the following errors

 [AVProVideo] Error: Loading failed.  File not found, codec not supported, video resolution too high or insufficient system resources.
 MediaPlayer error code:LoadFailed

The livestream url is resolved into a .m3u8 endpoint on google's youtube cdn, but the .m3u8 endpoint results in a 403 error, which causes the above errors.

AVProVideo was updated on 9th of may to version 1.9.1.4, one of the changes is "Fixed parsing bug in HLSStream" which may be related to the above issue.

YouTube Live is not working.
Normal YouTube videos can be played correctly.
Therefore, there might be some issue with VRC_SyncVideoStream and YouTube Live.

This is my output_log.txt:

(1)2019.01.16 02:50:10 Log        -  [VRC_TriggerInternal] 632.9056 SyncType_LiveStream via OnInteract executing [SendRPC (False, 0.000, 2, "StreamParent", SetSyncType, 147)]
